name: Smart Aircraft AI

reviewScope.boundary: Core readable implementation and settings reviewed; Antistasi integration not fully reviewed. Compiled execution, whole-mod build-out and physical/performance parity are not established.

findings.finding: Order detection accepts a current waypoint or native MOVE without separating source-authored movement from mission orders. On the hasOrders branch an active combat episode calls exitCombat before releaseControl.
findings.disposition: Replace with CBE task identity/native-order guards; never import this inference as an authority test.

findings.finding: Combat saves only waypoint position/type/behaviour/speed. Exit, breakaway and RTB delete all group waypoints. Exit reconstructs the old partial route, including when called after orders become visible.
findings.disposition: Reject route deletion/reconstruction. Retain CBE exact named temporary-leg ownership, edited-leg preservation and existing native route.

findings.finding: Cargo/driver/turret locks and copilot policy are overwritten, skills/fleeing changed without baseline restoration, and delayed GetOutMan callback force-seats with moveInAny. Delayed GetIn callbacks only recheck alive.
findings.disposition: Reject. Preserve mission skills/seats/locks; use existing scoped policies and default-off normal crew recall. No raw source import.

findings.finding: Damage/fuel/idle return intent is useful, but destination choice scans nearby entities without native knowledge and may return current position or arbitrary flat terrain. RTB service mutates damage/fuel/ammo after a delayed callback with no final task/owner check; rearm-disabled RTB does not clear isRTB in that path.
findings.disposition: Retain operational-readiness/return intent as an unresolved capability. Reject omniscient safe-base inference and synthetic service. Require a suitable known/authored recovery destination and finite existing-owner handover before implementing return.

findings.finding: Per-aircraft 0.1-second loop scans nearby missiles/rockets and targets; global discovery scans vehicles every3seconds. Server-only startup and lack of Local rebinding do not establish HC ownership support.
findings.disposition: Do not copy scheduler/world scans. CBE incoming warning event, finite generation/expiry response and shared flight lease already cover selected defensive admission intent; physical usefulness and cost remain unverified.

findings.finding: Targets are selected by side inequality and proximity, then revealed at4. Pursuit uses live target pose/velocity, while fire reports true after requests rather than observing a shot.
findings.disposition: Reject hidden target acquisition and request-as-result. Keep CBE native targetKnowledge/known target admission, belief-based plan, loaded station/operator selection and existing Fired result path. Exact priority/weapon classification descendants remain unread.

findings.finding: AA and delivery categories use classname/displayName substring lists, including launch_nlaw as an AA hint. Aircraft weapon inventory is limited to aggregate weapons and turret0/driver, then selected by vehicle ammo/name and fixed range.
findings.disposition: Retain threat-aware weapon suitability intent; use CBE loaded magazine/config simulation/airLock/usage flags, bounded station inventory and live eligible operator instead of copying names. Existing metadata classification still contains explicit pylon hints and needs modded-aircraft physical validation.

findings.finding: Emergency ejection relocates crew with setPosATL/setVelocity, force-seats into a generated parachute and later deletes surviving crew. Delayed callbacks do not retain task/owner authority. Settings expose this and synthetic service as defaults.
findings.disposition: Reject these ejection/cleanup shortcuts. No new source settings copied. Native emergency survival and legitimate support/service remain separate unresolved capabilities, not completed by rejecting the source method.

inspectedPaths: CortexAirAttack entry/control predicate, deadline, native known-target admission and finish path
CortexAirAttackPlan admission/header and weapon metadata classification
FlightLeaseAcquire selected body and FlightLeaseRelease full body
cbeComparison.retainedFoundation: Existing owner-local operation/FSM, flight token/owner, generation, stage deadlines, command-boundary permission, authored-order guards and exact temporary-leg retirement. These are code findings, not proven engine behaviour.
openGaps: Hard fuel exhaustion/native mobility loss now veto fresh attack admission and retire existing attack execution, with the same check at later native command boundaries. Low-fuel/damage service thresholds and recovery-destination/native RTB lifecycle remain unimplemented by this patch.
Known suitable recovery destinations, native landing continuity, resource-aware rearm/refuel policy and repeat-use lifecycle remain unreconciled.

CBE missile evasion still uses two bounded model-space velocity impulses. This is not a demonstrated natural-flight solution; replacement requires native manoeuvre/terrain/ownership assessment and later physical validation.
Physical attack, interruption, return, repeat, locality migration and measured cost remain unverified.

nextConcreteWork: Reconcile known/authored recovery destination and service policy with existing flight/task ownership before low-fuel/damage RTB. Do not re-review completed core readable bodies without changed source or a concrete failure. Antistasi adapter remains deferred compatibility; physical attack-abort/native handback/locality/repeat and cost await authorised audits.

validation.physicalAudits: Paused; no Arma launch or installed-game staging
validation.implementationCredit: Finite attack-readiness veto implemented and offline verified. No whole-mod percentage uplift or physical/performance acceptance.

attackReadinessImplementation20261027.sourceIntent: Avoid continuing combat when the aircraft is no longer operational; safe native handback precedes any later RTB policy.
attackReadinessImplementation20261027.affectedOwner: Existing AirAttackOperationStart/CortexAirAttack FSM and native command predicate only.
attackReadinessImplementation20261027.change: Fresh jobs refuse !alive/!canMove/fuel<=0 before flight lease/generation allocation, after existing-job handling so retained jobs can still retire. Active/direct execution rejects unavailable aircraft before planning using AIRFRAME_UNAVAILABLE and existing _finish without group-follow. Command permission rechecks canMove and positive fuel after planning.
attackReadinessImplementation20261027.preservedBaseline: Original stage deadlines, operation/generation/flight ownership, native knowledge/weapon gates, edited-waypoint preservation, exact speed/pilot feature restoration and authored-route handling. Defensive countermeasures unchanged.
attackReadinessImplementation20261027.cost: Two native readiness reads at fresh admission and each existing command predicate; one native readiness pair before planning. No worker/search/setting or new timer. Runtime cost unmeasured.
attackReadinessImplementation20261027.limitations: canMove is a native mobility veto and can reject a tail-rotor-damaged helicopter a player might still control. This is not a glide/autorotation/landing solution, damage model, guaranteed safety or RTB implementation. Existing cleanup flyInHeight/native continuation still needs physical review.
